178.news_title: Introducing the New 21.3 Inch Arcooda 4:3 Ratio LCD Monitor
178.long_description:
Arcooda is proud to introduce the new 21.3 inch 4:3 Ratio LCD Monitor, designed for arcade machines, retro gaming, industrial control systems, commercial displays and desktop applications.

Featuring a true 4:3 aspect ratio, this monitor is an ideal replacement for older CRT style displays and equipment that requires a traditional screen format. Its 21.3 inch IPS display delivers a clear image with 16.7 million colours, 500 nit brightness, an 1800:1 contrast ratio and a fast 1.7ms display lag.

The monitor supports a wide range of video signals, including native 15kHz, 24kHz and 31kHz inputs. With more than 160 pre-programmed display modes, including classic low-resolution  and VGA signals through to 1600 x 1200, it supports retro arcade boards, older gaming systems, modern PCs and commercial installations.

For arcade and gaming use, the monitor features Arcooda’s long developed firmware support for a broad range of game boards, including JAMMA, Neo Geo, Sega Model 2 and Model 3, Namco System 256 and Sega Tri force. The built in Auto Picture function helps centre the image quickly for a clean arcade display.

Connectivity is simple with VGA, DVI, HDMI and DisplayPort inputs. The monitor also includes a 3.5mm audio output with dual 10 watt audio support, making it suitable for installations where external speakers are required.

Installation is flexible thanks to VESA mounting support, rear mounting options and four included angle brackets. Each monitor comes with a powder-coated steel frame, VGA cable, HDMI cable and 12V power supply, helping make installation easier in arcade cabinets, desktop setups and custom commercial builds.

Whether you are restoring a classic arcade cabinet, replacing an ageing CRT monitor or creating a reliable 4:3 commercial display, the new 21.3-inch Arcooda LCD Monitor delivers versatile connectivity, strong image quality and broad signal compatibility in one professional solution.
